about_short_description.short_description: SalaryBox is a mobile application to track salary and attendance for business owners and employees.

product.name: Mobile Attendance
product.description: A system for real-time tracking of employee attendance using mobile devices, including selfie and location-based attendance.

product.name: Biometric Attendance
product.description: Integration of biometric devices for attendance management to record employee check-ins and check-outs securely.

product.name: Roster Management
product.description: A tool to create, customize, and distribute employee work schedules and shifts across multiple companies or branches.

product.name: Leave Management
product.description: A system to manage leave policies, requests, approvals, and custom leave types for employees.

product.name: Field Staff Location
product.description: A feature to live-track field employees’ locations, visits, and actual time spent at work sites.

product.name: Team Communication
product.description: A communication platform for broadcasting messages, chats, and notes to employees and teams.
